home.title: ORWO Family
home.description: Orwo is a 100+ year old company and brand. Orwo was founded in Wolfen, Germany as an off-shoot of the AGFA film company. Orwo made the first ever modern colour film way back in 1936. Orwo is now a group of vertically integrated motion picture companies.
